exposure: Cesarean scar pregnancy vs. cervical pregnancy
outcome: Recurrent cesarean scar or cervical pregnancies
cohort: 11 patients with either cesarean scar pregnancies (n=7) or cervical pregnancies (n=4)
finding: Combined intrachorial and systemic methotrexate treatment for cesarean scar and cervical pregnancies was 72.7% effective, with 100% uterine preservation and no recurrent ectopic pregnancies in those with follow-up.
